# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 3 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** Penance in the Rivers

---

**1** Adam said to Eve: 'Let us do penance, that God may take pity on us and restore us to paradise, or at least give us something to eat, for our souls are weighed down with grief.'

**2** Eve said to Adam: 'What penance shall we do?' Adam said: 'Let us stand in the water and fast; perhaps God will forgive us.'

**3** 'Go into the river Tigris and stand in it up to your neck for thirty-seven days. I will go into the river Jordan and stand there forty days, for I have sinned more than you — the transgression came through me.'

**4** Eve went into the river Tigris as Adam had commanded, and Adam went into the Jordan.

---
*LOGOS: formal equivalence; verse-only numbering.*
